title: Supply Chain Graph human decision v1
description: A record of a human decision about one proposal, bound to the exact proposal hash, packet hash, and source commit. A changed proposal or commit needs a new decision. The record describes where the authorization happened; a JSON file written by the same untrusted job is not itself a security boundary.

identity.description: The authenticated reviewer as the authorizing system knows them, for example a GitHub login.

method.description: Where the authorization happened. manual-record is a note, not a boundary.

reference.description: Review, approval, or deployment URL or ID in the authorizing system.

conditions.description: Conditions the reviewer attached, for example which tests must pass before merge.
